about_the_game:
A Boy Who Defies Fate and the Bond with His Loyal Pup

Taiki, a lonely boy, suddenly loses his only family—his beloved puppy, Musashi. Overcome with grief, he prays at a shrine, and Musashi is miraculously revived as an "Inubashira," a divine canine. However, he is bound by mysterious cursed chains. A shrine maiden, Kushina, appears and tells Taiki, "If you gather the sacred relics from the Realm of Roots, you can save Musashi."

Yet, this journey is not so simple. As they venture forth, an unexpected truth begins to unravel.

Set in a world where myths and yokai breathe life, this action-adventure follows a boy and his faithful pup as they challenge both fate and their unbreakable bond.

Three sacred relics, the whispers of yokai, and a hidden truth waiting to be uncovered.

And in the end, the final choice.

—Is the path you take to save Musashi truly the right one?

Game Features

Meet the Mononoke

Encounter unique Mononoke such as Nekomata, the cat spirit, Gama, the frog, Komi, the fox, and Mujina, the tanuki. Forge bonds with them, seek their aid, and battle against fearsome yokai to collect the sacred relics that will save Musashi.

A World of Painted Beauty

Explore the Mononoke Realm, a land brought to life with a painterly art style. Each region has its own distinct landscapes and atmosphere, creating a strange yet mesmerizing world.

An Adventure with Musashi

Your loyal companion Musashi, a puppy who once perished in the human world, must now fight to survive as a divine being. Work together to purify the yokai that threaten this land.

　

　

Interact with the Mononoke and Musashi

The Mononoke you meet have their own troubles and dilemmas. Assist them with Musashi by your side

—perhaps good fortune awaits those who lend a helping hand!

　

　

Battle Against Ferocious Yokai

Face relentless yokai and cleanse them through purification battles with Musashi’s divine powers.

　

　

Bond with Musashi

Musashi, your tiny Shiba Inu companion, will always be by your side. When exhaustion sets in, take a moment to rest and bond with him.

No matter what dangers await, as long as you're together—nothing is impossible.

　

　

　

Start your adventure in "Mononoke no Kuni" today!

Various Mononoke are waiting to interact with you in this world.
